_doc: The farm's background sound and music (scripts/soundscape.gd). beds: looping recordings by name. phases: the beds that may play in each part of the day (DayCycle.phase_name), one chosen by the day; seasons: beds kept to those seasons. weather: by weather state, how much quieter the bed (bed_db) and the music (music_db) go; in rain and storms they step well back so the rain (WeatherEvents' loop) is the sound heard, held by sound_test. fade: seconds of every cross-fade; check_every: seconds between looks. gain_db: the beds' level, set so the farm's sound sits well under the calls and clicks (the mix, held by sound_test: beds 10 dB or more under a call, music 8 or more). music: tracks (res:// paths, CC0 or credited), the rest between them (gap: seconds, least and most), the first after start (first_after), gain_db.
